tool_identity.digestProvenance: GitHub official release assets API SHA256 digest, independently checked against downloaded archive
tool_identity.limitations: Portable offline LLPC results are not the installed Windows driver. RGA default vk-spv-offline selects wave64 for these shaders; this workflow explicitly selects wave32 using the bundled compiler and reads the compiled ELF metadata. No driver, layer, registry entry or MSI is installed.

limitations: Offline LLPC auto-reflects descriptors; this is not the installed-driver pipeline or a runtime delivery/occupancy/timing measurement.
Compiled specialization coverage is exhaustive for the measured unfused Q32 window and FP8 GEMM families only; other operators are excluded.
Window heads, shifts and geometry are push constants; their actual dispatch mappings share one compiled specialization.
Static WMMA matches are instructions present in offline native ISA, not execution counts or throughput.
Source-closure hashes record caller-supplied correspondence, not source-to-SPIR-V reproducibility proof.
Reused reports are accepted only after exact input/spec/tool and specialized-SPV/ELF/ISA/CSV hash revalidation; an unrecorded original analysis-script hash remains null.
No model weights, raw tool binaries, raw ISA/ELF or GPU captures are included in this scalar summary.
